newsitem.title: USA: US sells 1,880 tonnes lead at avg $0.3439/lb.
newsitem.headline: US sells 1,880 tonnes lead at avg $0.3439/lb.

text.p: The U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center said Friday that it sold 1,880 tonnes of surplus lead to seven firms at an average price of $0.3439 per lb.
Parks Pioneer Metals Co of Milwaukee, Wisc. bought 20 tonnes of lead at a unit price of $0.3641 per lb.
Hammond Lead Products of Hammond, Ind. bought 100 tonnes of lead for $0.3502 per lb, 100 tonnes at $0.3501 per lb, 100 at $0.3476, 100 at $0.3451 per lb and 100 at $0.3426 per lb.
Amerway Inc of Altoona, Pa purchased 40 tonnes of lead at $0.3501 per lb.
Hirsch Metals Corp of Boca Raton, Fla. bought 20 tonnes of lead at $0.3480 per lb, 20 tonnes at $0.3460, 20 at $0.3435 and a final 20 tonnes at $0.3410 per lb, DNSC said.
It said East Penn Mfg Co Inc of Lyon Station, Pa. bought 200 tonnes of lead for $0.3453 per lb and another 200 tonnes at $0.3443 per lb.
Forty tonnes of lead were sold to Non-Ferrous Processing of Brooklyn, N.Y. at a unit price of $0.3432 per lb.
Exide Corp of Reading, Pa. purchased the final 800 tonnes of lead at $0.3407 per lb, DNSC said.
The next bid opening for lead is December 5, it said.
